leadText: Deluxe Media Inc. (stylized as simply Deluxe) is a production company and recording studio founded in 1915 currently owned by the firm Platinum Equity that produces the English dubs of Pokémon animation through their offices in .
plainText:
Deluxe Media Inc. (stylized as simply Deluxe) is a production company and recording studio founded in 1915 currently owned by the firm Platinum Equity that produces the English dubs of Pokémon animation through their offices in . 

==English projects==
Pokémon Generations
Pokémon: Twilight Wings
Pokémon: Hisuian Snow

==English voice directors==
Ellyn Stern (Pokémon Generations)
Laura Post (Pokémon: Twilight Wings, Pokémon: Hisuian Snow)
